wc:minerva-avatar.summary: Picture of a person with an initials / icon fallback.
wc:minerva-avatar.description: A picture of a person, falling back to their initials (or custom fallback content) when there is no image or it fails to load (`<Avatar>` of React). The fallback is exposed as a single image (`role="img"`) named after the person, so screen readers announce "Ada Lovelace" rather than the letters "AL".

properties.name: src
properties.description: Image URL; the initials of `name` are shown without it or when it fails to load

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the person: initials, alt text and accessible label

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Alternative text of the image ("" for a decorative avatar); defaults to the label

properties.name: size
properties.description: Size preset, or a number of pixels

properties.name: stacked
properties.description: Uses tighter margins for overlapping avatars

wc:minerva-avatar-group.summary: Overlapping group of avatars with a "+N" indicator.
wc:minerva-avatar-group.description: Overlapping avatars with an optional "+N" indicator (`<AvatarGroup>` of React). `max` limits the visible avatars (the hidden ones are added to the indicator); `count` adds avatars that are not rendered at all. Each child element is wrapped in its own item box inside the shadow root (manual slot assignment), exactly like the React component, so the overlap / hover styles of React apply unchanged.

properties.name: count
properties.description: Number of additional avatars, shown in the "+N" indicator

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum number of avatars displayed; the others are counted in "+N"

parts.name: item
parts.description: The wrapper of each visible avatar

parts.name: count
parts.description: The "+N" indicator of the hidden avatars

fallback.title: 回退内容、尺寸与 max
fallback.description: 首字母取前两个单词的首字母（或第一个汉字）；fallback 或 children 可替代它。size 也接受像素值，AvatarGroup 的 max 会把其余头像折叠为 +N。

AvatarProps.src: 图片地址，未提供时显示 name 的首字母
AvatarProps.name: 用户名，用于首字母、替代文本和无障碍标签
AvatarProps.size: 头像尺寸：预设值（xsmall 24px、small 32px、medium 48px、large 64px、xlarge 80px、xxlarge 96px）或像素数
AvatarProps.stacked: 使用更紧凑的间距以叠放头像
AvatarProps.alt: 图片的替代文字；传入 "" 表示装饰性头像
AvatarProps.aria-label: 头像的无障碍名称（也是图片的默认替代文字）
AvatarProps.fallback: 没有图片时代替首字母显示的自定义内容
AvatarProps.children: 没有 name 时使用的回退内容（例如图标）

AvatarGroupProps.count: 额外头像的数量，显示为“+N”
AvatarGroupProps.max: 最多显示的头像数；其余头像计入「+N」指示（与 count 相加）

cssVars.--avatar-group-overlap: 每个头像与前一个头像的重叠距离
cssVars.--avatar-size: 所有头像的宽高（覆盖尺寸预设；数值型 size 属性优先）
cssVars.--avatar-bg-color: 未设置颜色时的背景色（默认 --info-color）
cssVars.--avatar-stacked-overlap: 堆叠头像与前一个头像的重叠距离
